<documents>
<document id="card-fraud-lock">
WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆ"LockedˆbyˆTallowbrook",ˆourˆfraudˆsystemsˆhaveˆplacedˆaˆfraudˆlockˆonˆit.ˆThisˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆaˆfreezeˆyouˆsetˆyourself.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆWeˆlockˆaˆcardˆwhenˆweˆseeˆactivityˆthatˆlooksˆlikeˆfraud,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆfraudˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆgetˆitˆremovedˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆanˆopenˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆanswerˆit.ˆTappingˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆusuallyˆremovesˆtheˆlockˆstraightˆaway.ˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆnoˆalert,ˆmessageˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆtheˆFraudˆteam.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆandˆneitherˆcanˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆoftenˆmuchˆsooner.ˆ##ˆMeanwhileˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆstillˆarriveˆwhileˆyourˆcardˆisˆlocked.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆstillˆuseˆBrookPayˆandˆtransfers,ˆunlessˆtheˆFraudˆteamˆhasˆrestrictedˆthoseˆtoo.ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆfraudˆalertˆbyˆgivingˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcode.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆandˆourˆfeesˆWhenˆyouˆuseˆanˆATMˆoutsideˆBrookLink,ˆupˆtoˆtwoˆdifferentˆchargesˆcanˆapply.ˆThey'reˆeasyˆtoˆmixˆup.ˆ##ˆTheˆATMˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆThisˆisˆsetˆbyˆwhoeverˆownsˆtheˆATM,ˆnotˆbyˆus.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm,ˆandˆit'sˆaddedˆtoˆtheˆwithdrawalˆamount.ˆForˆexample,ˆifˆyouˆwithdrawˆcashˆandˆtheˆownerˆchargesˆaˆsurcharge,ˆoneˆtransactionˆforˆtheˆtotalˆappearsˆinˆyourˆactivity.ˆ##ˆTallowbrook'sˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆThisˆisˆourˆfee,ˆchargedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆcalledˆ"Out-of-networkˆATMˆfee".ˆIt'sˆ$2.50ˆonˆBasicˆandˆonˆPlusˆafterˆyourˆfreeˆwithdrawals,ˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆPremiumˆpaysˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆperˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆcreditedˆautomaticallyˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆAvoidingˆbothˆUseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆTheyˆneverˆchargeˆaˆsurcharge,ˆandˆweˆneverˆchargeˆaˆfeeˆforˆthem.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
